method: Round 1 (field map, before any research question): per facet, top-scoring surveys and frontier papers since 2024 by relevance + momentum; then top-scoring central papers overall, from scripts/reading_priority.py (weights {'relevance': 0.5, 'influence': 0.25, 'momentum': 0.25}; percentiles over 51418 papers with SPECTER2 vectors). Screen status ignored, recorded per paper. Deterministic; a reading list is a discovery decision, not evidence.
